protocol.purpose: Compare the prior skill with this candidate on routing and observable decisions; static checks do not establish AI behavior.
protocol.execution: Subscription CLI only after the operator approves the concrete protocol. Use fictional fixtures and intercepted writes, then the approved Sudolab scope for integrated flow. No private real-person Notepad, paid API or background action.
protocol.comparison: Run the same cases against base ffba59ac9d6959dbf692e557fb166b14c7842214 and the final candidate. Preserve transcripts and score each expected outcome independently. A wrong write, lost entry, stale snapshot or unauthorized shared effect fails its case.
protocol.release_limit: Unrun cases are not a routing, behavioral or non-regression pass.
